description: This 210 m² apartment offers spectacular views of the Seine and the Eiffel Tower.Composed of an entrance leading to a large living room facing the Place du Trocadéro, extended by a corner dining room bathed in light, a spacious living room overlooking the courtyard and a separate kitchen; on the night side, four bedrooms including a large suite with dressing room and bathroom, shower rooms and guest toilets.Large balconies allow you to enjoy the outdoors and unobstructed views all around the apartment,The spaceThis 210 m² apartment offers spectacular views of the Seine and the Eiffel Tower.Composed of an entrance leading to a large living room facing the Place du Trocadéro, extended by a corner dining room bathed in light, a spacious living room overlooking the courtyard and a separate kitchen; on the night side, four bedrooms including a large suite with dressing room and bathroom, shower rooms and guest toilets.Large balconies allow you to enjoy the outdoors and unobstructed views all around the apartment,Guest accessThrough the main door of the buildingThere is an intercom Code 0714AThe accommodation is on the 6th and top floor by elevator on the rightOther things to noteWe love animals but they are not allowed in the accommodation, thank you for your understanding.Out of respect for the allergies of some guests and for the maintenance of the accommodation, pets are not allowed.Any reservation that does not comply with this rule may be canceled.
